test.command: if [ "${OS:-}" = Windows_NT ]; then export LLVM_PROFILE_FILE_NAME=printobserver-types-%p.profraw; fi; cargo llvm-cov nextest -p printobserver-types --no-report --no-tests=pass

schemas.command: cargo test --locked -p printobserver-types -p printobserver-printer-api -p printobserver-vision-api -p printobserver-supervisor-api -p printobserver-core -p printobserver-obico -p printobserver-server --test schemas

schemas-update.command: PRINTOBSERVER_SCHEMAS=write cargo test --locked -p printobserver-types -p printobserver-printer-api -p printobserver-vision-api -p printobserver-supervisor-api -p printobserver-core -p printobserver-obico -p printobserver-server --test schemas
